title: Memory retrieval precision — story-scope filter + TF-IDF scoring
description: Improve graph-manager.js searchEntities to enforce story-scope isolation (only return nodes belonging to current project_id) and add TF-IDF token-overlap scoring for relevance ranking instead of plain FTS5 ordering.
action: In graph-manager.js searchEntities(), add required `scope` parameter with {projectId, workspaceId}. Add WHERE clause filtering entities by JSON_EXTRACT(properties, '$.projectId') = scope.projectId. Replace FTS5 rank with token-overlap scoring: tokenize query and entity name/properties into lowercase word sets, compute overlap count as score, ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT N.

criteria: src-tauri/bin/sidecar/graph/graph-manager.js searchEntities accepts a scope parameter with projectId
src-tauri/bin/sidecar/graph/graph-manager.js contains 'projectId' or 'project_id' in searchEntities function body
Search results are ranked by token-overlap score, not FTS5 default rank
convergence.verification: Insert entities with different projectId values, call searchEntities with a specific projectId, verify only matching entities returned and ranked by relevance to query
convergence.definition_of_done: Memory retrieval for an open novel returns top-3 relevant entries scoped to current story with no false-positive matches from other projects

files.change: Add scope parameter {projectId, workspaceId}. Add SQL WHERE filter: JSON_EXTRACT(properties, '$.projectId') = ? for non-null projectId. Replace FTS5 ranking with token-overlap scoring function.

implementation: Update searchEntities(query, entityType, limit) signature to searchEntities(query, entityType, limit, scope={}) where scope = {projectId, workspaceId}
Add scope filter: if scope.projectId is provided, append AND JSON_EXTRACT(e.properties, '$.projectId') = ? to the WHERE clause with scope.projectId as parameter
Add token-overlap scoring function computeRelevanceScore(queryTokens, entityText) that tokenizes both to lowercase words, computes intersection size / union size (Jaccard), returns float 0-1
In searchEntities, fetch results then re-rank by computeRelevanceScore(tokenize(query), entity.name + ' ' + JSON.stringify(entity.properties)), sort descending, return top-N
Ensure backward compatibility: if scope is omitted or scope.projectId is null, skip scope filter (includes all entities as before)

reference.pattern: graph-engine.js _buildScopedEntityPredicate() already generates SQL scope predicates — follow same pattern

rationale.chosen_approach: TF-IDF token overlap is lightweight and doesn't require vector DB — sufficient for name/property matching within a story scope
decision_factors: Semantic search deferred to M2 per roadmap
rationale.tradeoffs: Token overlap won't catch semantic synonyms — acceptable for M1 scope
